j.applique.placementInset.title: Distance of the placement line inside the edge (Punch: 1–1.5 mm)
j.applique.freeEdge.title: Free-edge appliqué: placement 5 mm inside the edge, no tack-down, one stop for the spray glue and the fabric, then the cover
j.foam.name: 3D foam
j.foam.title: Satin sewn over a foam sheet: 3D relief. A stop before the object to lay the foam; sew it last
j.foam.hint: No fill underlay: straight-stitch contour (and a centre walk from 4 mm), denser satin ({mm} mm), caps on the open ends. The machine stops first to lay the foam.
j.foam.contourPasses.title: Straight-stitch contour: 1 pass, 2 at most
j.foam.densityFactor.title: Divides the normal satin's spacing (1.45: provisional, to check at the first stitch-out)
j.foam.caps.title: They close the open ends (T, L, E) on the shape's edge, so the foam does not stick out
j.foam.sheetNote: 3D foam: ballpoint needle, softer tension, never put the foam in the hoop, not for children's clothing.
j.layered3d.name: Layered 3D
j.layered3d.title: Raised column: growing inner layers sewn one over the other, then the final layer that wraps them
j.layered3d.hint: From the column the program makes the inner layers by itself: the core (two underlay layers and the contour), then wider layers, last the layer that wraps them all. The edges are staggered: no stitch within 0.3 mm of one of the layer before.
j.layered3d.layers.title: 2 to 4 inner layers, plus the final one
j.layered3d.underlayZigzagSpacing.title: Spacing of the core's zig-zag underlay: wider = higher
j.layered3d.shrinkPerLayer.title: How much narrower each inner layer is than the next, both sides together (0.6 mm: provisional, to tune at the first stitch-out; not under 0.6 to stagger the edges by 0.3 mm)
j.layered3d.baseThread.title: The thread you put in the machine for the inner layers (with a metallic thread: polyester under, the metallic only on top)
j.layered3d.sheetNote: Layered 3D: the inner layers in the thread chosen for them, the special thread only on the final layer.
j.issue.foamLast.title: 3D goes last
j.issue.foamLast.detail: «{name}» is a satin over foam, but other objects are sewn after it: they would run over the foam and flatten it. Move the foam to the end of the sequence.
j.issue.layeredThin.title: Layered 3D under 6 mm
j.issue.layeredThin.detail: The column is {width} mm wide: under {min} mm the layers have no room to rise and the relief does not show. Widen it or use a normal satin.
